facts.text: Ao Lie runs to talk to Wukong and Macaque, especially Macaque, when they seem to be leaving.
Wukong and Macaque thank Ao Lie for helping to free them from Spider Queen's rule.
Ao Lie helps free Wukong and Macaque first by rescuing them from the dungeon.
Ao Lie helps destroy Spider Queen after rescuing Wukong and Macaque from the dungeon.
Ao Lie does not want Macaque to leave.
Ao Lie has found a kindred spirit in Macaque.
Macaque says he will be back.
Ao Lie is always welcome on Flower-Fruit Mountain.
Wukong and Macaque are happy to go home to Flower-Fruit Mountain after centuries of imprisonment.
Wukong talks about fighting monsters in his old stomping grounds.
Macaque talks about feeling the sun on his skin.
Macaque talks about breathing the mountain air.
Wukong and Macaque see Flower-Fruit Mountain for the first time in centuries.
Flower-Fruit Mountain is exactly as Wukong and Macaque remember it.
Wukong and Macaque are overcome with emotion at finally being home.

events.text: Party ends and Megapolis begins rebuilding and removing traces of Spider Queen's rule
Ao Lie talks to Wukong and Macaque as they prepare to leave; Macaque gives Ao Lie a hug and says he'll be back
Wukong and Macaque say goodbye to Ao Lie, MK, Mei, and Bai Long Ma before going home
Wukong and Macaque return to Flower-Fruit Mountain and see their home for the first time in centuries
